title: Paper v2 live session failure leaves run in RUNNING state
description:
When a Paper v2 live session terminal-fails, the associated paper_v2.run can remain RUNNING. In the observed production diagnostic, session psess_4ae1b8aa651b46cd9f418989a328df74 is FAILED after a TDX minute data fetch failure, but run prun_2a12a2a5fd314f61b585f31e99fccd4e remains RUNNING with completed_at NULL and error_json NULL.

Impact: monitoring, ledger checks, live dashboard, and future remediation cannot trust run/session state consistency. Scheduler does not continue this session because it filters by session status, but the run-level durable state is stale.
reproduce_command: Query production/dev Paper v2 DB after a live TDX minute fetch terminal failure: compare paper_v2.trade_session.status for psess_4ae1b8aa651b46cd9f418989a328df74 with paper_v2.run.status for prun_2a12a2a5fd314f61b585f31e99fccd4e.
required_verification: Regression test proves a terminal live-session failure also marks the current run FAILED with error_json and completed_at.
Regression test proves session_events and run_events/errors preserve the original DATA_UNAVAILABLE context.
Read-only audit script or management path identifies and optionally repairs historical session=FAILED/run=RUNNING mismatches.
closure_requirements: No paper_v2.run remains RUNNING when its owning latest live session is terminal FAILED for the same trade date.
Data quality smoke either passes or reports no new run/session state divergence for the fixed scenario.
Production remediation is explicit and audited if historical rows are updated.
non_goals: Do not silently mark successful partial live executions as SUCCEEDED.
Do not weaken strict live data fail-fast checks without BUG-041 policy changes.
Do not change scheduler tickable status filtering as part of this issue unless required by tests.

events.note: Created from production Paper v2 live-session diagnostic after 2026-05-14 live simulation failure.
